assumptions.message: Recognized domain as 'news' which natively brings Comments, Reactions (bookmarking/saving), and Follow (following sections) as specified by domain rules.
Reader article visibility is enforced via a backend visibility policy where status == published, treating public/readers identically.
Cover image was added to Article to support the lead story and front page visual presentation in the editorial news design.
Editors have bypass permission to review, update, publish, or request changes on any writer's article.

Design direction: Bookmark & Read-Later (Minimal & Direct + Demo); palette Paper warm white + ink neutral + minimal accent + tag colors; fonts Minimalist Monochrome Editorial (Playfair Display / Source Serif 4); from ui-ux-pro-max@28b3b8dee8c9
article.submitForReview: it answers the Article
article.requestChanges: it answers the Article
article.schedule: it answers the Article
article.publish: it answers the Article
Built on the News domain
Comments added to Article
Reactions added to Article
Follow added to Article
article.list: who sees a record follows the visibility policy readerArticleVisibility
article.get: who sees a record follows the visibility policy readerArticleVisibility
'domain' is not valid (String should match pattern '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$'); left out
look 'swiss' replaced by 'soft': three quiet looks offer no choice
'Published Articles' is computed by article.countThisWeek (added)
'Drafts in Review' is computed by article.countWhereStatusInReview (added)
'Changes Requested' is computed by article.countWhereStatusChangesRequested (added)
'Scheduled Articles' is computed by article.countWhereStatusScheduled (added)
'Articles by Section' is computed by article.countBySection (added)

The look follows the requirement (Look: editorial and trustworthy, a classic serif for headlines, off-white paper and a navy accent.): accent #1e3a8a; background #fbfbfa; serif headings (Playfair Display)
4 seeded record photo(s) from Unsplash, credited where they show
3 workflow step(s) could not be bound to the app; see the Business tab

unresolved.message: Can an editor directly edit a draft's content/headline during review, or must all edits originate from the assigned writer via revision?
Should scheduled articles be automatically published by an automated background cron job when scheduledAt is reached?
Can published articles be unpublished or archived by editors in future versions?
